title: File exceeds 1000 lines (1469 lines total)
detail: fields.py contains 1469 lines defining all OVo field types and their validators. Files of this size are hard to navigate and slow IDE tooling. Suggested fix: split into sub-modules (e.g. fields/primitives.py, fields/compound.py, fields/enums.py).

title: Two validator methods raise `ValueError` for invalid type; `TypeError` is more appropriate
detail: Lines 1164 and 1192 raise `ValueError` to signal a wrong-type argument. Python's convention (and PEP 8) is that `TypeError` is raised when the type of an argument is wrong, while `ValueError` signals a value that is the right type but outside the allowed range. Callers that distinguish these exception types (e.g. in generic validation frameworks) will misclassify the error. Suggested fix: replace `raise ValueError(...)` with `raise TypeError(...)` at both sites.
